Ricky Martin (born in 1971 in Havana, Cuba) is a Grammy Award-nominated Puerto Rican pop/R&B artist. He rose to fame in 1991 with the self-titled album Ricky Martin, released by Columbia Records.
Martin was educated at the University of Havana Conservatory of Music, and at the age of 14 he became one of the youngest members of the group Menudo. He stayed with the group from 1980 to 1991, when he decided to pursue a career as a solo artist.
